posts.title: A Reset Link Is a Credential
bullets: Use cryptographically random, single-use reset tokens with a short expiry.
Rate-limit reset requests and return the same response for existing and unknown accounts.
After suspected compromise, invalidate old sessions and outstanding recovery links.
posts.takeaway: Test token replay, expiry, and session invalidation.
posts.caption:
A password reset link is a credential. Use unpredictable, single-use, short-lived tokens; rate-limit reset requests; and avoid revealing whether an account exists. After suspected compromise, invalidate old sessions and recovery links.
